name: web-dark-intelligence-mobile-site-on-glass-tiles
title: Dark mobile site with a glowing dotted globe and blue gradient 'Intelligence.' on a phone lying on blue glass blocks
whatItIs: A phone lies on translucent blue glass cubes against a pale background showing a dark page with a small logo, a dotted glowing globe and a big blue-gradient word 'Intelligence.' with a paragraph and a scroll-now mouse icon.
whatItMeans: Secretive and global; a dark globe screen on bright glass gives cool contrast.
techniques: Place a dark UI on bright glass blocks.
Use a dotted globe as hero art.
Fill a heading with a blue gradient.

vocabulary.definition: A heading filled with a colour gradient.
Translucent cubes used as a stage.
